name: IVF clinics
headline: A calm welcome for a sensitive first call.
description: Give new callers time, clarity and a helpful next step. TheAiAutomators captures consultation requests and routes treatment questions to your clinical team.
pain: The first inquiry can come with uncertainty. A caller deserves a patient response, even when your reception team is occupied.
example: I’d like to understand how to arrange my first consultation.
alt: A couple discussing a fertility consultation with clinic staff

name: Dental clinics
headline: You’re with a patient. Your next caller still gets an answer.
description: Handle opening-hour questions, capture check-up requests and give your team a clear record of who needs a callback.
pain: Between chairside care and a busy reception desk, appointment inquiries can arrive at the wrong moment. Keep the conversation moving.
example: Can I arrange a dental check-up this week?
alt: A dentist explaining a dental scan to a patient

name: Dermatology
headline: Turn treatment inquiries into clear next steps.
description: Help callers find approved information about your services and arrange a consultation with the right member of your team.
pain: Questions about cosmetic services and medical consultations need different next steps. Your front desk should capture the inquiry without guessing at the answer.
example: Do you offer consultations for skin concerns?
alt: A dermatologist examining a patient’s skin during a consultation

name: Eye & vision
headline: Make arranging an eye appointment easier.
description: Give callers a helpful answer about your opening hours, location and appointment process while your team focuses on care.
pain: Routine appointment calls compete with people already waiting in your clinic. Handle the basics and prepare the details your team needs.
example: I’d like to arrange a routine eye examination.
alt: An eye specialist examining a patient with a slit lamp

name: Hotels
headline: A helpful welcome before your guest arrives.
description: Answer questions about your property, capture stay dates and room preferences, and pass reservation inquiries to your front desk.
pain: Guests call while you’re checking someone in, coordinating housekeeping or handling a late arrival. Keep new stay inquiries moving.
example: I’m planning a two-night stay. Is breakfast included?
alt: A hotel staff member welcoming a guest at reception
